detected_fault: BSOD (Blue Screen of Death) issues related to thermal throttling or driver/BIOs conflicts
suggested_solution: Check for BIOS updates and install the latest version.
Run a virus scan and malware removal tool to ensure the device is free from any malicious software.
Update drivers for all hardware components to the latest versions.
Consider upgrading the graphics card or adding an external GPU (eGPU) for improved gaming performance.
